research.searchCoverage: Official MailerLite API, authentication, international company identity and security materials reviewed on 2026-09-13; confirmed historical incident coverage and remediation reviewed; no current unresolved credible incident identified, without a breach-free claim.

breach.finding: Unauthorized access to the internal admin panel affected 70 customer accounts after forensic review; four cryptocurrency-related accounts were used for phishing campaigns.
breach.remediation: MailerLite secured systems, intensified security training and internal processes, fast-tracked FIDO2 deployment, and recorded fixes by the targeted support-system provider.
breach.residualRisk: Historical support/admin control failure remains relevant; current authenticated qualification is unverified.

exception.adoption: Adopt the international MailerLite API despite the waived historical incident; coverage includes the origin read ops plus Composio HTTP tools.
exception.incident: 2024-01-23 unauthorized internal admin-panel access; forensic update reduced affected accounts from 117 to 70 and identified four phishing campaigns.
exception.remediation: Official notice records system security actions, FIDO2 rollout, training/process changes, and support-provider fixes.
exception.residualRisk: Historical control failure remains relevant; current security posture and live authentication are unverified.
exception.usefulness: Subscriber, group, field, segment, campaign, automation, webhook, form, batch, timezone, import, account, and e-commerce HTTP tools with credential healthcheck.

research.searchCoverage: Current official MailerLite API, authentication, international company identity and security materials reviewed on 2026-09-13. The 2024 incident and remediation are recorded; current coverage is not a breach-free claim.

incidents.summary: Unauthorized internal admin-panel access affected 70 customer accounts after forensic review; four crypto-related accounts launched phishing campaigns.
incidents.remediation: MailerLite secured systems, accelerated FIDO2 rollout, strengthened training/processes, and recorded support-provider fixes.
incidents.limitation: Historical event; current live authentication and security posture unverified.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.
